# BlackSilk CLSAG vectors (docs/transactions.md §6.1). Test data, read by
# crypto/tests/clsag_vectors.rs. One `name = value` per line; hex unless noted.
#
# accept.<v>.*               consensus accept vectors, derived by the in-test
#                            reference signer from the spec (explicit nonces).
# reject_pending_cb_b1.*     z = 0, D = identity. Currently ACCEPTED by
#                            clsag::verify; must be rejected once CB-B1 lands.
# regression.*               implementation output (clsag::sign with an all-zero
#                            RNG). Wallet-side regression pin, not consensus.
#
# Fields: pi (decimal real index), m (message), p (spend secret), z (commitment
# secret), alpha (nonce), simulated_s (s[i] nonces for i != pi, zero at pi),
# ring_P / ring_C (16 points each, concatenated), pseudo_out (C'), Hp
# (Hp("key-image", P[i]) for i = 0..15), I, D, mu_P, mu_C, W, c (c[0..16]),
# sig (c0 || s[0..16] || D, 576 bytes). Scalars are 32-byte little-endian,
# points compressed Ristretto255.
#
# The reject vectors are single-field changes of accept.pi6 and are defined in
# the test source (reject_vectors); they are not repeated here.
